messages:
Maya R: heads up — gpu-dev cluster image pulls to ECR started failing ~10m ago, lots of `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` and `connection reset` errors in the kubelet logs. I'm seeing 403s from the sidecar too. Anyone touching privatelink/vpce for ecr recently?

Alex M: I deployed a new interface endpoint for ECR API in the shared infra VPC yesterday (for a different team). Did we enable Private DNS on it? If not, DNS could be resolving to public ECR endpoints and then hitting our egress path.

Samira K: I checked `kubectl describe pod` for a failing node — pods on node ip 10.104.12.34. Node has NAT egress via NAT-GW in the infra account, so if DNS points public the flow goes out to IGW/NAT and back. But the errors look TLS-y.

Mike (ops): quick checks: run `dig +short public.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com` from a bastion in the same subnet and from a node. Also check endpoint attributes:
```
aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --filters Name=service-name,Values=com.amazonaws.us-west-2.ecr.api
```

Nisha R: ran those — from a node: `public.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com` resolves to 52.x.x.x (public). The VPC endpoint exists but Private DNS was NOT enabled when it was created. Also saw the endpoint ENIs in subnets 10.200.0.0/24 and 10.200.1.0/24.

Maya R: aha. So traffic is going out to public ECR over NAT. Why would that fail though? We have NAT and IGW for egress.

Alex M: two things: 1) our corporate egress firewall blocks outbound to some S3/ECR ranges unless via proxy, and 2) the endpoint's security group only allows inbound from 10.150.0.0/16 (an older CIDR). If traffic is SNAT'd to the NAT EIP, the source IP becomes the EIP and the endpoint SG wouldn't match — but SGs are evaluated on ENI side so that only matters if traffic actually hits the endpoint ENI. Right now, because DNS resolved public, traffic shouldn't hit the interface endpoint at all.

Samira K: I found one failing node's kubelet logs with this snippet: `dial tcp 52.94.76.201:443: connect: connection reset by peer` and the proxy logs show `403 Forbidden` when attempting to use the corporate egress proxy. So the node egress path to public ECR is blocked.

Mike (ops): OK two fixes: enable Private DNS on the existing interface endpoint so ecr API hostnames resolve to the endpoint ENIs, and update the endpoint SG to allow the cluster node CIDR (10.104.0.0/16) and ephemeral ports. Also check NACLs on the endpoint subnets — there was a deny rule added last week for ephemeral ports for another project.

Nisha R: confirmed NACL on 10.200.0.0/24 had explicit deny on ephemeral range 32768-65535 (why??). That would break return traffic to the ENI if allowed. So we need to remove that deny or add allow entries.

Maya R: steps I'm going to take now: (1) enable Private DNS on the VPCE, (2) associate the endpoint's private hosted zone to the infra VPCs, (3) update endpoint SG to allow 10.104.0.0/16:32768-61000 (ephemeral), (4) remove the NACL deny. I'll coordinate with Mike before changing NACLs.

Alex M: FYI commands I used to check endpoint: 
```
# check private-dns enabled
aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --vpc-endpoint-ids vpce-0abc1234 --query 'VpcEndpoints[0].PrivateDnsEnabled'
# check ENIs and SG
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-abc123
```

Mike (ops): I'll standby to approve the NACL change. Also please add a temporary rule allowing 10.104.0.0/16 -> endpoint SG so we can test quickly.

(10 minutes later)

Nisha R: Private DNS enabled, endpoint private hosted zone associated to infra VPC, endpoint SG updated to allow 10.104.0.0/16:32768-61000, removed the deny on the NACL.

deploy-bot: deployment gpu-images-puller restarted on node 10.104.12.34 (rollout id: r-2025-04-09).

Maya R: image pulls successful on restarted pods. Verified `docker pull` from node now resolves to the endpoint ENI private IP and connects over the VPC endpoint.

infra-bot: reminder — created infra playbook ticket INFRA-452 to document privatelink ecr enablement checklist and NACL guidance.

Alex M: nice. Follow-up actions: 1) update our infra-terraform to set `private_dns_enabled = true` for ECR endpoints, 2) ensure endpoint SGs use dynamic references (`aws_security_group_rule` with source = module.cluster_cidr) rather than hardcoded CIDRs, 3) add a monitoring alert for NACL changes in endpoint subnets.

Maya R: thanks all. Leaving the temporary SG open for 1 hour then will tighten to node ENIs. :thumbsup:

Samira K: adding note to runbook: if ECR pull errors + x509/connection reset -> check Private DNS first, then NACL, then SGs.

Mike (ops): great triage. Closing the incident when playbook ticket is merged.
